import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define file paths for all sources
    path_source_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_0.csv"  # IdCausa, Causa
    path_source_1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_1.csv"  # IdDeteccion, Deteccion
    path_source_2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_2.csv"  # Main detailed data
    path_source_3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_3.csv"  # IdActividad, Actividad
    path_source_4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_4.csv"  # IdFactor, Factor

    # Load all source dataframes
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_source_0)
    df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(path_source_1)
    df_main = pd.read_csv(path_source_2)
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_source_3)
    df_factor = pd.read_csv(path_source_4)

    # --- Data Cleaning & Preparation ---

    # Strip whitespace from string columns in all dataframes to avoid join issues
    for df in [df_causa, df_deteccion, df_main, df_actividad, df_factor]:
        str_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns
        df[str_cols] = df[str_cols].apply(lambda x: x.str.strip())

    # The main dataframe (df_main) already contains textual columns for Causa, Deteccion, Actividad, Factor
    # We want to replace these textual columns with their corresponding Ids from the lookup tables,
    # and also keep the textual columns as in the target schema.

    # Step 1: Map 'Causa' text in df_main to 'IdCausa' from df_causa
    # Because df_main already has a 'Causa' column (text), and df_causa has IdCausa and Causa (text),
    # we join on the textual 'Causa' to get IdCausa.
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_causa'))
    # After merge, df_main has columns: ... 'IdCausa' (from df_causa), 'Causa' (original text)
    # Drop any duplicate or unwanted columns if any (like 'IdCausa_from_causa' if appeared)
    # But suffixes prevent duplicate columns, so no duplicates expected.

    # Step 2: Map 'Deteccion' text in df_main to 'IdDeteccion' from df_deteccion
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_deteccion'))

    # Step 3: Map 'Actividad' text in df_main to 'IdActividad' from df_actividad
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_actividad'))

    # Step 4: Map 'Factor' text in df_main to 'IdFactor' from df_factor
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_factor, on='Factor', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_factor'))

    # After these merges, df_main has columns:
    # - IdCausa (from df_causa)
    # - IdDeteccion (from df_deteccion)
    # - IdActividad (from df_actividad)
    # - IdFactor (from df_factor)
    # plus original textual columns.

    # The target schema expects these Id columns as integers.
    # Convert them to integer type, handling missing values by filling with -1 or NaN as appropriate.
    id_columns = ['IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdActividad', 'IdFactor']
    for col in id_columns:
        # Convert to Int64 dtype to allow NaNs
        df_main[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_main[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # The target schema has a column 'Dir. vi.' which corresponds to 'Dir. vi.' in df_main.
    # Rename columns if needed to exactly match target schema.
    # Check if 'Dir. vi.' column exists, if not, check for similar columns.
    # Also, 'Precipitaciones' column exists in df_main but not in target schema, so drop it.

    # Drop 'Precipitaciones' if present
    if 'Precipitaciones' in df_main.columns:
        df_main = df_main.drop(columns=['Precipitaciones'])

    # Ensure columns order and presence matches target schema exactly.
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor'
    ]

    # Some columns might be missing or have different names, check and fix:
    # For example, 'ID' in target schema corresponds to 'ID' in df_main (uppercase)
    # 'Dir. vi.' column name must be exact, check if it exists
    if 'Dir. vi.' not in df_main.columns:
        # Try alternative column names with similar meaning
        possible_cols = [col for col in df_main.columns if 'Dir' in col and 'vi' in col]
        if possible_cols:
            df_main = df_main.rename(columns={possible_cols[0]: 'Dir. vi.'})
        else:
            # If not found, create with NaNs
            df_main['Dir. vi.'] = pd.NA

    # Ensure all target columns exist in df_main, if not create with NaNs
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_main.columns:
            df_main[col] = pd.NA

    # Select and reorder columns exactly as target schema
    df_target = df_main[target_columns]

    # Convert data types according to target schema:
    # Fecha: string (keep as is)
    # IdAhogado, IdPersona, ID, IdActividad, IdCausa, IdDeteccion, IdFactor: integer
    int_cols = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']
    for col in int_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # Float columns:
    float_cols = [
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Edad', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max',
        'T_min', 'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia'
    ]
    for col in float_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

    # V_Viento is integer
    if 'V_Viento' in df_target.columns:
        df_target['V_Viento'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['V_Viento'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # The rest are strings, ensure string type (object)
    str_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in int_cols + float_cols]
    for col in str_cols:
        df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype('string')

    # Save the transformed dataframe to the target path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
